shortDescription: Manage services in an Oracle database

options.name: available_instances
options.description: The RAC instances on which the service can run in case of failure of preferred_instances. Comma-separated list

options.name: database_name
options.description: The database in which the service will run

options.name: force
options.description: Adds the 'force' flag to the srvctl command

options.name: hostname
options.description: The host of the database if using dbms_service

options.name: password
options.description: The password to connect to the database if using dbms_service

options.name: pdb
options.description: The pdb which the service is attached to

options.name: port
options.description: The listener port to connect to the database if using dbms_service

options.name: preferred_instances
options.description: The RAC instances on which the service will actively run. Comma-separated list

options.name: role
options.description: Role of the service (primary, physical_standby, logical_standby, snapshot_standby)

options.name: service_name
options.default: database_name. Will be set to the pdb-name if pdb is set
options.description: The service_name to connect to the database if using dbms_service.

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the service. 'status' will just show the status of the service

options.name: username
options.description: The database username to connect to the database if using dbms_service
